513-- **Stack_Underflow**: The error condition in which the Stack_Evaluator attempts to pop an operand from the Evaluation_Stack to satisfy an operator but the Evaluation_Stack holds fewer operands than the operator requires.
514-- **Surplus_Operands**: The error condition in which, after the Stack_Evaluator has consumed the entire RPN_Token_Sequence, the Evaluation_Stack holds more than one value, indicating a malformed Expression with operands that no operator consumed.

args.response: Refined Requirement 40. Addressed gaps: (1) replaced the vague temporal qualifier "within the same display update" with the observable "before awaiting further User input" and added explicit level-shift/landing semantics so testers agree on where values appear; (2) disambiguated criterion 4's "zero values" to mean "no pushed value" (empty) vs. the numeric value zero; (3) added one new error-path criterion (P0, state preservation) covering Backend_Service error/unavailability during an RPN operation so the stack is observably retained. Preserved all glossary terms (RPN_Mode, Stack_Display, Stack_Level, Enter_Control, aria-live) and referenced requirement numbers; added no implementation details. Budget respected (1 new criterion).
